milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the oak_planks structure (placed at spawn-relative ~5-6, 0-1, 5-6) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the center of the 6-block structure. Max distance 16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing range, and facing tolerance 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle_boat places it directly into the player's inventory. The player has 5 jungle_planks pre-given and must use the nearby crafting table (3x3 grid required) to craft exactly 1 jungle_boat using the U-shape recipe. Checking inventory for the crafted item is the most reliable verification method.
